title: Subscription receipt choices
decision: A receipt states an amount and a number of months, with 1, 3, 6 and 12 months offered in chat; at most three receipts of a shop may wait; duplicates are looked for across all shops and shown only to administrators; the image is not forwarded to anyone and is opened through a signed link; the file is kept three years as the specification says pending advice; a receipt can be sent in any mode, even suspended; a column stated_months was added
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 54
rationale: ADR-019 names stored hashes and flagged duplicates and leaves the rest open
